01 / EXPLORE

Find what matters.

Browse policies by party, topic and status. Search titles and summaries, and follow links to the official source.

02 / REFLECT

Make up your own mind.

Choose from strongly agree to strongly disagree, or mark yourself unsure. Add private notes and change your response as you learn more.

03 / COMPARE

See your pattern.

View a party-by-party summary of the policies you have rated. Unanswered policies don’t count towards your match.

Your opinions belong to you.

Ratings and notes stay on your device. The app has no advertising, no account and no political tracking. Public policy updates are downloaded separately from your responses.

Read the privacy policy

A comparison, not a recommendation

The decision is still yours.

A match percentage reflects the listed policies you rated—not a complete manifesto, a prediction or advice on how to vote.

The catalogue distinguishes confirmed 2026 commitments from standing/current policies. News can alert us to an announcement; an official party source must support the wording before it is published in the app. Coverage and policy positions can change.

Policy Match is independent. It is not affiliated with the Electoral Commission or any political party.
